name: Leaving assigned area
operationalDefinition: Moving more than 10 feet from his assigned area or group, or out of the room, without adult permission.
baseline: Average 6 times a day (10 school days, Aug 2026)

name: Verbal outburst
operationalDefinition: Yelling above conversational volume and/or pushing materials off the desk, lasting at least 5 seconds.
baseline: Average 4 a day (10 school days, Aug-Sep 2026)
